build_vae_encoder: build a VAEEncoder module with configurable channels, resolutions, and attention types for video latent encoding
build_vae_decoder: build a VAEDecoder module with upsampling blocks and optional tanh output for video latent decoding
create_resnet_block: create a ResnetBlock with normalization, convolution, dropout, and optional timestep embedding projection
create_attention_block: create an AttnBlock or LinAttnBlock with self-attention or linear attention for feature refinement
test_vae_forward: test the VAEEncoder and VAEDecoder forward passes with sample tensor inputs
